exposure: type of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean)
outcome: postpartum sexual function (Female Sexual Function Index total score and dimensions: desire, lubrication, orgasm, pain, satisfaction)
finding: The total score of sexual function was significantly lower in women with uterine, cystocele, and rectocele prolapse.
mod_finding: The total score of sexual function was significantly different between vaginal delivery and cesarean groups, although individual dimensions of sexual function (desire, lubrication, orgasm, pain, satisfaction) were not significantly different.
